description: Phase 9 benchmark and replay fixture matrix for agent-loop maturity work.

scenarios.summary: Crash after delegated planning checkpoint but before first tool call.
expected: task resumes from planning checkpoint
no duplicate tool execution
environment lease remains valid or is safely reacquired

scenarios.summary: Crash after a replay-safe tool finishes but before delegated result publication.
expected: result publication occurs once
artifacts are not duplicated
checkpoint classification explains replay decision

scenarios.summary: Local delegated task uses multiple tools and emits phase/progress/timing telemetry.
expected: supervisor receives progress updates
per-tool duration is non-zero
waiting reasons and current phase are inspectable

scenarios.summary: Pause a local delegated task at a safe boundary and resume from checkpoint.
expected: pause acknowledged at safe boundary
resume continues from saved checkpoint
operator surfaces show paused and resumed states coherently

scenarios.summary: Initial answer is heuristically acceptable but later rejected by review/test outcomes.
expected: reflection confidence is downgraded
strategy is marked lower priority for future injection
audit trail links reflection to failing outcome

scenarios.summary: Low-confidence result triggers bounded corrective re-plan on replay-safe steps only.
expected: corrective retry executes only replay-safe actions
approval or dangerous side-effect policies remain enforced
revised result shows measurable improvement

scenarios.summary: Corpus contains duplicate lessons and mutually contradictory guidance.
expected: duplicates are grouped
conflicts are surfaced rather than silently merged
retrieval ranking prefers higher-confidence outcome-backed memory

scenarios.summary: Directive-local memory conflicts with older repo-global memory.
expected: retrieval explains scope precedence
operator can inspect why one memory won
losing memory remains auditable and reversible

scenarios.summary: Subagent publishes a blocker and partial finding before task completion.
expected: supervisor sees partial finding mid-task
publication preserves authorship and confidence
shared memory can later promote the finding without losing provenance

scenarios.summary: Supervisor changes execution guidance for an active delegated task via shared cognition.
expected: child sees revised steering within bounded latency
steering change is audited
task continues without hidden state transition

scenarios.summary: Multiple subagents publish conflicting hypotheses for the same directive before final resolution.
expected: both hypotheses remain auditable with authorship preserved
supervisor can steer using the conflicting context without losing either branch
prompt retrieval stays bounded to scoped high-signal notes
